name: EXM_EXPENSES
description:
EXM_EXPENSES stores detailed information about expense items for individual expense reports
         you enter.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a specific expense item.

columns.name: CARD_USAGE_ID
columns.description:
Card usage identifier that is associated with an existing
                        card usage

columns.name: RCPT_MISSING_THRESHOLD_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates whether the expense item receipt amount is below a
                        specific threshold percentage.

columns.name: VALIDATION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description:
Types of exceptions for an expense item. Possible values are
                        NULL for old expenses that need to be revalidated, E for expenses with at
                        least one error, W for expenses that have no errors but have warnings, and C
                        for expenses without any errors or warnings.

columns.name: TRXN_AVAILABLE_DATE
columns.description:
Date when a corporate card transaction is available for
                        inclusion in an expense report.

columns.name: CARD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a specific corporate card.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description:
Person identifier of the individual on the corporate
                        card.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description:
Assignment identifier of the individual on the corporate
                        card.

columns.name: EXPENSE_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a specific expense report.

columns.name: ITEMIZATION_PARENT_EXPENSE_ID
columns.description:
Unique identifier of the parent expense of an itemized
                        expense item. Possible values are NULL indicating that the expense is not
                        itemized, -1 indicating that the expense is a parent line with itemization,
                        and greater than 0 indicating that the expense is an itemized child line and
                        the value is the parent line's identifier.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description:
Sequence in which expenses items are entered into an expense
                        report.

columns.name: REIMBURSABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description:
Amount to be reimbursed to the individual in reimbursable
                        currency for this expense.

columns.name: ORIG_REIMBURSABLE_AMOUNT
columns.description:
Original amount to be reimbursed to the individual for this
                        expense.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of an expense item.

columns.name: JUSTIFICATION
columns.description: Reason an expense was incurred.

columns.name: MERGED_PARENT_EXPENSE_ID
columns.description:
Identifies the expense to which the duplicate expenses are
                        merged.

columns.name: VISITED_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates whether the user has confirmed the
                        expense.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description:
Date when the expense occurred or the calculated value of
                        the start date of an expense that spans multiple days.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description:
Last date of an expense that spans multiple days. For
                        expenses paid using a corporate card, this is the date when the transaction
                        occurred.

columns.name: RECEIPT_DATE
columns.description: Date when the expense occurred.

columns.name: CC_PAYMENT_DUE_DATE
columns.description:
Date when the corporate credit card amount needs to be
                        paid.

columns.name: RECEIPT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Receipt currency of an expense item.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description:
Rate that represents the amount one currency can be
                        exchanged for another at a specific point in time.

columns.name: RECEIPT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the receipt in the receipt currency.

columns.name: DAILY_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount consumed in a day for the expense.

columns.name: TIP_AMOUNT
columns.description:
Amount of tip given in the transaction. This helps to manage
                        cases where receipts have different amount because of the tips
                        involved.

columns.name: EXPENSE_SOURCE
columns.description:
Source of an expense item, such as cash or corporate
                        card.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a specific expense template.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a specific expense type.

columns.name: EXPENSE_TYPE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description:
Grouping of expense types and additional data fields that
                        are relevant for a particular grouping of expenses. An example is airfare.
                        This grouping allows expense types to include information such as class of
                        fare, merchant, ticket number, location from, and location to.

columns.name: FUNC_CURRENCY_AMOUNT
columns.description:
Amount to be reimbursed to the individual in functional
                        currency for expenses incurred.

columns.name: CREDIT_CARD_TRXN_ID
columns.description:
Unique identifier of a specific corporate card
                        transaction.

columns.name: RECEIPT_REQUIRED_THRESHOLD
columns.description:
Amount above which receipt is required for the expense
                        item.

columns.name: CC_PREPAID_INVOICE_ID
columns.description:
Identifier of the payment request generated to reimburse the
                        individual.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a specific location.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_ATTENDEES
columns.description:
Number of people that attended the event for which an
                        expense was incurred. For example, the number of people that attended a
                        business dinner or an entertainment event.

columns.name: MERCHANT_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description:
Receipt number on the receipt issued by the
                        merchant.

columns.name: MERCHANT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the merchant where the expense was incurred.

columns.name: MERCHANT_REFERENCE
columns.description:
Purchase identification of a transaction provided by the
                        merchant at the point of sale.

columns.name: MERCHANT_TAX_REG_NUMBER
columns.description:
Unique sequence of letters and/or numbers assigned to a
                        party or party site, by a tax authority, when it is registered and by which
                        the party or party site registration will be identified.

columns.name: MERCHANT_TAXPAYER_ID
columns.description: Tax payer identifier of the merchant.

columns.name: COUNTRY_OF_SUPPLY
columns.description: Country where the supplier resides.

columns.name: VEHICLE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description:
Grouping of vehicle types such as, company, private, or
                        rental.

columns.name: VEHICLE_TYPE
columns.description:
Types of vehicles for which mileage reimbursement is
                        permitted such as, car, motorcycle, and van.

columns.name: FUEL_TYPE
columns.description:
Types of fuel for which fuel charge reimbursement is
                        permitted.

columns.name: NUMBER_PEOPLE
columns.description: Number of passengers in the vehicle.

columns.name: DAILY_DISTANCE
columns.description: Distance traveled in a day for business.

columns.name: DISTANCE_UNIT_CODE
columns.description:
Unit of the distance traveled, such as kilometer and
                        mile.

columns.name: AVG_MILEAGE_RATE
columns.description:
Average mileage rate including additional applicable rates
                        such as passenger rates and rates for hauling a trailer.

columns.name: DESTINATION_FROM
columns.description: Starting or departure location of the trip.

columns.name: DESTINATION_TO
columns.description: Ending or arrival location of the trip.

columns.name: DISPLAYED_FROM_ADDRESS
columns.description:
Full address of the starting or departure location of the
                        trip.

columns.name: DISPLAYED_TO_ADDRESS
columns.description:
Full address of the ending or arrival location of the
                        trip.

columns.name: TO_ADDRESS_CITY
columns.description: City of the ending or arrival location of the trip.

columns.name: ROUND_TRIP_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the trip is a round trip.

columns.name: TRIP_DISTANCE
columns.description:
Total distance traveled during a business trip for which
                        mileage reimbursement is requested.

columns.name: LICENSE_PLATE_NUMBER
columns.description: License plate number of the vehicle.

columns.name: MILEAGE_RATE_ADJUSTED_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicator of whether the mileage rate was adjusted after
                        expense report approval.

columns.name: TRAVEL_TYPE
columns.description:
Indicator of whether a flight is domestic or
                        international.

columns.name: TICKET_CLASS_CODE
columns.description:
Cabin class of a flight or ship, for example business or
                        economy.

columns.name: TICKET_NUMBER
columns.description: Airline ticket number.

columns.name: FLIGHT_NUMBER
columns.description: Airline flight number.

columns.name: DEPARTURE_LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the departure location.

columns.name: RATE_PER_PASSENGER
columns.description:
Applicable mileage rate per passenger for this
                        expense.

columns.name: PASSENGER_RATE_TYPE
columns.description:
Passenger rate type used for mileage reimbursement for this
                        expense.

columns.name: PASSENGER_AMOUNT
columns.description:
Total reimbursement for carrying passengers in the
                        vehicle.

columns.name: RANGE_LOW
columns.description:
Lower limit of the distance threshold range used in mileage
                        rate calculation.

columns.name: RANGE_HIGH
columns.description:
Higher limit of the distance threshold range used in mileage
                        rate calculation.

columns.name: UOM_DAYS
columns.description:
Number of per diem expense days calculated based on the unit
                        of measure.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_REASON
columns.description:
Reason for updating allocations for this report
                        line.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_SPLIT_CODE
columns.description:
Indicator of how this expense line is split. A null value
                        indicates that the line is not split.

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Tax code applicable to the expense item.

columns.name: AWT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Alternate tax withholding group identifier.

columns.name: AUDIT_ADJUSTMENT_REASON_CODE
columns.description:
Reason code for reimbursable amount to the individual during
                        audit.

columns.name: AUDIT_ADJUSTMENT_REASON
columns.description:
Reason for adjusting the reimbursable amount to the
                        individual during audit.

columns.name: POLICY_VIOLATED_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicator of whether the expense violated company
                        policies.

columns.name: POLICY_SHORTPAY_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicator of whether the expense is short paid due to policy
                        noncompliance.

columns.name: RECEIPT_VERIFIED_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicator of whether the auditor verified the receipt for
                        this expense.

columns.name: RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicator of whether this expense requires a
                        receipt.

columns.name: RECEIPT_MISSING_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicator of whether the receipts are missing for this
                        expense.

columns.name: DAILY_LIMIT_POLICY_LINE_ID
columns.description:
Identifier of the daily limit policy associated to the
                        row.

columns.name: JUSTIFICATION_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicator of whether the expense requires
                        justification.

columns.name: ITINERARY_RESERVATION_ID
columns.description: Travel reservation for which expense was created.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description:
Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to
                        the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description:
Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is
                        incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at
                        the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has
                        updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description:
Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of
                        the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description:
Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update
                        of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description:
Who column: indicates the user who last updated the
                        row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description:
Who column: indicates the session login associated to the
                        user who last updated the row.

columns.name: RECEIPT_TIME
columns.description:
Date and time of the transaction. This helps to
                        differentiate transactions made on same day by their accounting
                        time.

columns.name: EXPENSE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description:
Classification of an expense item such as business or
                        personal.

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: Location where the expense was incurred.

columns.name: REIMBURSEMENT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description:
Currency of the amount to be reimbursed to the individual
                        for expenses incurred.

columns.name: INACTIVE_EMP_PROCESS_ID
columns.description:
Request identifier of the job that processes the expenses of
                        inactive employees. Applicable only if the expense is processed after the
                        employee is terminated.

columns.name: PREPARER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the person who created the expense.

columns.name: CHECKOUT_DATE
columns.description:
Date when a person departs a place associated with an
                        accommodation expense category.

columns.name: CC_PREPAID_REQUEST_ID
columns.description:
Request identifier of the job that processes a corporate
                        card transaction for reimbursement to corporate card issuer. Applicable only
                        when payment liability is company pay.

columns.name: EMP_DEFAULT_COST_CENTER
columns.description: Default cost center assigned to an individual.

columns.name: ORIG_RECEIPT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Original amount of the receipt for this expense.

columns.name: ORIG_EXPENSE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Expense type of this expense before it was changed.

columns.name: ORIG_EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Exchange rate of the expense before it was changed.

columns.name: IMG_RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicator of whether this expense requires an imaged
                        receipt.

columns.name: PERSONAL_RECEIPT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of the expense that is marked as personal.

columns.name: PERSONAL_AMT_PAID_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates whether the personal amount is paid by the
                        user.

columns.name: RECEIPT_MISSING_DEC_REQ_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicator of whether an expense item with missing receipts
                        is required to submit missing receipts declaration.

columns.name: MOBILE_EXPENSE_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicator of whether the expense item was created from a
                        mobile device.

columns.name: MASKED_CC_NUMBER
columns.description:
Masked corporate card number that is obtained by scanning a
                        transaction receipt for a cash expense.

columns.name: ZONE_CODE
columns.description:
Zone code of a zone type that is referred by this
                        expense.

columns.name: START_ODOMETER
columns.description: Mileage Start Odometer reading.

columns.name: END_ODOMETER
columns.description: Mileage End Odometer reading.

columns.name: AGENCY_NAME
columns.description: Name of agency where car rental expense incurred.

columns.name: PASSENGER_NAME
columns.description: Name of airline flight passenger.

columns.name: FLIGHT_DURATION
columns.description: Airline flight duration in hours.

columns.name: EXPENSE_CREATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description:
Method of expense item creation, such as mobile iOS device
                        or mobile Android device.

columns.name: ACCOM_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of accommodation used during a trip.

columns.name: LONG_TERM_TRIP_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if trip is a long term trip.

columns.name: LONG_TERM_TRIP_START_DATE
columns.description: Date when long term trip started.

columns.name: MULTI_DESTINATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if trip contains multiple destinations.

columns.name: PREPAID_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the expense is prepaid.

columns.name: TRAVEL_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Method of travel used during a trip.

columns.name: POLICY_WARNING_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates whether the expense item is marked with a
                        warning.

columns.name: POLICY_WARNING_REASON_CODE
columns.description:
Reason code for a warning that an expense auditor applies to
                        an expense item. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_WARNING_REASON.

columns.name: SPEND_AUTH_LINE_ID
columns.description: Spend authorization expense line identifier.

columns.name: AUTH_TRXN_NUMBER
columns.description:
The credit card transaction authorization code. The value is
                        obtained from the credit card charge.

columns.name: DEDUCT_COMMUTE_DISTANCE_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates whether commute distance is deducted when
                        calculating trip distance.

columns.name: DEDUCT_ROUND_TRIP_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates whether round trip commute distance is deducted
                        when calculating trip distance.

columns.name: COMMUTE_DISTANCE
columns.description:
Commute distance during business trip for which mileage
                        reimbursement is requested.

columns.name: CALCULATED_TRIP_DISTANCE_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates whether trip distance is calculated by Google
                        Maps.

columns.name: SPLIT_ALLOCATION_SET_ID
columns.description: Specific split allocation set identifier.

columns.name: AUTO_SUBMIT_DATE
columns.description:
Date on which the expense is added to a report and submitted
                        by the Automatically Submit Expense Reports process. A null value indicates
                        that the expense is not yet ready to be picked up by the process.

columns.name: TAX_PRODUCT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description:
Tax product category assigned to expense item to determine
                        the recoverable tax for an expense.

columns.name: CC_AUTHORIZATION_IDENTIFIER
columns.description:
Unique identifier that maps authorization requests to credit
                        card transactions in the transaction files when the files are uploaded to
                        Expenses. The identifier links the original authorization data to all
                        related transactions, such as reversals, adjustments, confirmations and
                        chargebacks.

columns.name: GEOCODE_FROM
columns.description:
Latitude and longitude values of the starting location for
                        mileage expenses in JSON format.

columns.name: GEOCODE_TO
columns.description:
Latitude and longitude values of the destination for mileage
                        expenses in JSON format.

columns.name: YEARLY_LIMIT_POLICY_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the yearly limit policy line.

columns.name: DAILY_LIMIT_ATTEND_POLICY_ID
columns.description:
Unique identifier of the daily limit attendee policy
                        line.

columns.name: YEARLY_LIMIT_ATTEND_POLICY_ID
columns.description:
Unique identifier of the yearly limit attendee policy
                        line.

columns.name: AUTO_PERSONAL_FLAG
columns.description:
An indicator of whether an expense is automatically
                        categorized as personal based on the derived expense type.

columns.name: CC_NETWORK_REFERENCE_NUMBER
columns.description:
Unique identifier generated by the payment network for each
                        corporate card authorization request.

columns.name: CC_MERCHANT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description:
Code assigned to the merchant by the credit card company to
                        classify the type of business.

columns.name: APPROVAL_STATUS_CODE
columns.description:
Indicates the automatic approval status of the
                        expense.

columns.name: VENDOR_EXPENSE_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description:
Unique identifier of an expense used for grouping similar
                        expenses.

columns.name: AUDITOR_REJECTED_FLAG
columns.description:
Indicates whether the expense got rejected by the
                        auditor.

columns.name: AUDITOR_REJECTION_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the auditor's reason for rejection.

columns.name: CHECKIN_DATE
columns.description:
Date used as the check-in date for accommodation and the
                        rental start date for car rentals.
